title: Electrodynamics I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one which causes the polarisation of the atom."
The local field is the one which causes the polarisation of the atom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a toroid with any magnetic material in its interior."
A convenient experimental arrangement is a toroid with any magnetic material in its interior.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the electric dipole moment per unit volume of the dielectric."
Polarisation P is defined as the electric dipole moment per unit volume of the dielectric.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the applied potential difference per unit thickness of the dielectric when the dielectric just breaks down."
Dielectric strength is the applied potential difference per unit thickness of the dielectric when the dielectric just breaks down.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used very widely in capacitors."
Dielectrics are used very widely in capacitors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used at high frequencies as it has low loss."
Teflon is used at high frequencies as it has low loss.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those materials, which respond very strongly to the presence of magnetic fields."
Ferromagnetic materials are those materials, which respond very strongly to the presence of magnetic fields.
fib: ______ are used in many electrical or electronic circuits, they provide coupling between amplifier stages, smoothen the output of power supplies.
Capacitors
Capacitors are used in many electrical or electronic circuits, they provide coupling between amplifier stages, smoothen the output of power supplies.
______ is called the magnetic 'intensity' vector, a name that rightly belongs to B, but, for historical reasons, has been given to H.
vector H
The vector H is called the magnetic 'intensity' vector, a name that rightly belongs to B, but, for historical reasons, has been given to H.
______ is the applied potential difference per unit thickness of the dielectric when the dielectric just breakdown.
breakdown voltage
The breakdown voltage is the applied potential difference per unit thickness of the dielectric when the dielectric just breakdown.

Note that L
Note that L is the orbital angular momentum of the electron.

Barium titanate and its modifications
Barium titanate and its modifications are the best examples of such materials.
______ are used by the electrical engineers in calculations relating to electromagnets, motors and dynamos.
magnetic circuit formulae
The magnetic circuit formulae are used by the electrical engineers in calculations relating to electromagnets, motors and dynamos.

magnetic effects
The magnetic effects are a completely quantum mechanical phenomena.
